learningReferences.lesson: Repeated same-CA same-second same-direction trades plus verified direct transfers justify a coordination hypothesis, not a confirmed common owner.
Track sender and recipient inventories together; a token transfer is not an external buy. Do not sum provider P&L blindly across transferring wallets.
Keep losses and bounded unmatched/open samples. A profitable showcased coin does not establish profitable long-run wallet performance.
Short holding periods, arbitrage tags and unknown private execution conditions prevent assuming that delayed observation reproduces the wallet returns.
Same symbols on different CAs are separate samples. Trading synchrony alone does not prove a shared narrative or explain why the wallet bought.

limitations: Only two activity pages per wallet; pagination is incomplete for four wallets.
Seven-day and 30-day provider summaries overlap and must not be added.
Provider realized profit is not independently reconstructed whole-wallet net P&L; missing unrealized P&L is unknown, not zero.
These wallets were discovered from profitable token-trader rankings and are selection-biased.
Same-second matching must use a one-to-one match for chain+CA+side+timestamp, and distinct transactions.
No strategy, automatic follow list, paper ledger, real-wallet execution, scheduled job or monitor restart was changed.
